projects.name: kinematic-character
projects.kind: platformer with moving and one-way platforms; CharacterBody2D player; 530 by 495; 120 ticks a second

changes.name: broken
changes.what: the player's collision mask is emptied, so it falls through the floor

changes.name: harmless
changes.what: the player's sprite is tinted; nothing it does changes (the engine's checks pass, as on the project unchanged; CI has no vision key, so the verdict is needs-review, as #379 requires: an accept needs vision, and an outside project counts as verified only after a run with vision, Sean's call on #398)

changes.name: invisible
changes.what: the player's sprite is hidden; it moves exactly as before, so the engine's checks pass and only a visual observer can tell (#330): with vision it must not be accepted, because no player is drawn where the engine says it is

projects.name: dodge-the-creeps

changes.name: broken

changes.name: harmless
